pixel_comparisons.method: each candidate and its baseline are captured at their own element box (identical content, identical alignment) and compared channel-wise inside the browser; mean_abs_delta is the mean per-pixel maximum channel difference on 0-255
pixel_comparisons.caveat: a static contrast number from one background sample is not proof of contrast over every translucent backdrop; these are backdrop-variation measurements, reported separately from any static contrast figure

static_contrast_report.note: Only the solid-fallback state has a single opaque surface colour, so only it yields a real static contrast number. A translucent surface has no one background colour; its readability is evidenced separately by the backdrop-variation comparisons in pixel_comparisons. A static figure from one background sample is never offered as proof for every translucent backdrop.
